blocks.prompt: 3. Find an equation of the graph whose x-intercepts are \(x = -1\) and \(x = -2\) and which passes through the point \((-3, 2)\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do x-intercepts aur ek extra point diya hai, yani yeh 1.2 wala sawal hai, bas graph ki jagah maloomaat likhi hain.
Intercepts se factors milenge: \(x = -1\) se \((x + 1)\) aur \(x = -2\) se \((x + 2)\).
Phir point \((-3, 2)\) rakh kar \(a\) nikalenge.
Aakhir mein teeno di hui shartein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: x-intercepts \(x = -1\), \(x = -2\); point \((-3, 2)\) graph par hai.
Maloom karna: graph ki equation.
Tareeqa: factor form \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\), phir teesra point rakh kar \(a\).

Factor form likhein
\[y = a(x + 1)(x + 2) \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: \(x = -1\) se \((x - (-1)) = (x + 1)\), aur \(x = -2\) se \((x + 2)\).
Dhyan dein: dono roots negative hain, is liye dono factors mein plus aayega.

\(a\) nikalein
\[2 = a(-3 + 1)(-3 + 2)\]
\[2 = a(-2)(-1) = 2a\]
\[a = 1\]
Kyun: \((-3, 2)\) graph par hai, is liye (1) ko satisfy karta hai. Do negatives ka product positive: \((-2)(-1) = 2\).

Equation likhein
\[y = (x + 1)(x + 2)\]
\[y = x^{2} + 3x + 2\]
Kyun: \(a = 1\) rakha aur expand kiya: \(x^{2} + 2x + x + 2\).

Tasdeeq:
\[y(-1) = 0,\ y(-2) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(-3) = 9 - 9 + 2 = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Dono intercepts aur diya hua point, teeno sahi. \(a = 1 > 0\), is liye yeh parabola upar khulta hai.
